words.definition: not needed; more than what is required
words.example: The audit found several unnecessary expenses in the budget.
words.exampleTranslation: 稽核發現預算裡有幾筆不必要的支出。

words.definition: in a way that matches or corresponds to the situation just mentioned
words.example: The schedule changed, so please plan your tasks accordingly.
words.exampleTranslation: 行程改變了，所以請相應地調整你的工作安排。

words.definition: a round fruit with red, green, or yellow skin
words.example: The cafeteria offers a free apple with every lunch set.
words.exampleTranslation: 自助餐廳的每份午餐套餐都附贈一顆免費蘋果。

words.definition: relevant or appropriate to a particular situation
words.example: This discount is only applicable to first-time customers.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個折扣只適用於首次消費的顧客。

words.definition: a public sale where items are sold to the highest bidder
words.example: The old office furniture will be sold at auction next week.
words.exampleTranslation: 舊的辦公家具下週會進行拍賣。

words.definition: a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by a rail
words.example: The hotel room comes with a small balcony overlooking the city.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間飯店房間附有一個俯瞰市區的小陽台。

words.definition: a room or floor of a building that is below ground level
words.example: Extra inventory is stored in the basement.
words.exampleTranslation: 多餘的庫存都存放在地下室。

words.definition: before a particular time or event
words.example: Please submit your expense report beforehand so it can be approved in time.
words.exampleTranslation: 請事先提交你的報帳單，才能及時獲得核准。

words.definition: relating to cooking or the kitchen
words.example: The chef trained at a top culinary school in Paris.
words.exampleTranslation: 這位主廚曾在巴黎一所頂尖的烹飪學校受訓。

words.definition: a film or program presenting factual information about a subject
words.example: The company produced a short documentary about its founding.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司製作了一部關於創立過程的短紀錄片。

words.definition: a decline in economic activity or business performance
words.example: The industry saw a downturn during the last recession.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個產業在上一次經濟衰退期間出現了下滑。

words.definition: a sudden violent shaking of the ground caused by movement of the earth's crust
words.example: The office has an emergency plan in case of an earthquake.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室有一套應對地震的緊急計畫。

words.definition: graceful and stylish in appearance or manner
words.example: The venue has an elegant design suited for formal events.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個場地的設計優雅，很適合正式活動。

words.definition: more than what is necessary, reasonable, or normal
words.example: The manager flagged the excessive overtime hours this month.
words.exampleTranslation: 經理注意到這個月的加班時數過度了。

words.definition: not specific or branded; general in nature
words.example: The pharmacy offers a cheaper generic version of the medicine.
words.exampleTranslation: 藥局有提供比較便宜的通用版藥品。

words.definition: a style of music characterized by improvisation and syncopated rhythms
words.example: A live jazz band will perform at the company gala.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司晚宴會有現場爵士樂團演出。

words.definition: the length of time that something or someone exists or lasts
words.example: The product comes with a lifetime warranty.
words.exampleTranslation: 這項產品附有終身保固。

words.definition: the rubbing and kneading of muscles for relaxation or therapy
words.example: The wellness room offers a free ten-minute massage during breaks.
words.exampleTranslation: 健康室在休息時間提供十分鐘的免費按摩。

words.definition: to make something as large or great as possible
words.example: The new layout maximizes storage space in the warehouse.
words.exampleTranslation: 新的配置讓倉庫的儲存空間達到最大化。

words.definition: not strong or severe in effect; gentle
words.example: Customer feedback about the price increase was surprisingly mild.
words.exampleTranslation: 顧客對漲價的反應意外地溫和。
